name: Christmas giftbox and thermos store images
picture_standard: This is for a kids' co-op escape game for ages 8 and up: friendly, funny and cozy. Rich, polished 3D animated-movie style (soft light, glossy rounded shapes). A SQUARE round game icon: the object inside a glowing ring on a deep purple background with a few small sparkles and swooshes - exactly the same layout, ring, glow and style as the FIRST attached picture (the candy cane icon). The object fills most of the circle; nothing else inside. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, brand marks or emblems, no famous characters.

assets.picture: A big wrapped Christmas PRESENT, red with a wide gold ribbon both ways and a big shiny gold bow on top; its lid is lifted a tiny crack, and a pair of curious cartoon eyes peeks out from the dark gap under the lid - a kid hiding inside. Playful and cheeky, not scary.

A cozy red THERMOS flask with a white snowflake shape on it, its cup-lid off and filled with steaming hot cocoa topped with whipped cream and little marshmallows, two more small mugs beside it as if to share with friends, a curl of steam rising.
